scientific_target: Reduce candidate area and matched-random success while preserving complete recovery of the 19 Campanula microdonta development clusters; quantify the smallest defensible recovery envelope when complete local recovery is expensive.
generator_leakage_rule: 2026 field coordinates and outcomes are never generator inputs; they are read only after a candidate universe or score family has been frozen for each experiment.

1km_joint_best.method: pre-2026 GBIF nearest-prototype ESA NDVI state

500m_count_best.method: NDVI state + GSI physical terrain / coast features

layers.source: Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI) numerical elevation models
layers.resolution: 1 m / 5 m / 10 m depending on coverage; development features derived on the shared ~25 m terrain surface
layers.development_result: Terrain alone reaches 19/19 at 1 km but needs about 7.5% of the ~100 m universe. Terrain physics does not beat the NDVI 1-km frontier, but NDVI + physical terrain improves the 500-m complete-recovery envelope from 34.47% to 26.98%.

Simple 100/250 m land-cover composition, entropy, and edge-mix are negative ablations: cover-only needs about 36.46% of the grid for 19/19 at 1 km and the best terrain/cover mixture is terrain-only. The water class remains useful operationally for explicit coast-distance derivation.

layers.source: ESA WorldCover annual Sentinel-2 NDVI composite 2021 v2 (p90, p50, p10)
layers.development_result: Full NDVI state (p50, p90-p10 amplitude, 100/250 m local means, local amplitude mean) reaches 19/19 at 1 km with 867 cells = 3.8053% and matched-random complete recovery 29.75%. NDVI gradient/heterogeneity/cover-transition variants do not beat this frontier.

layers.source: Derived from the pinned ESA NDVI composite and pre-2026 GBIF prototypes
layers.resolution: same 10 m source / ~100 m candidate universe
layers.development_result: These methods shrink candidate counts strongly (as low as 380 cells = 1.67%) but make matched-random complete recovery much easier (about 53-79%). They are rejected because compression alone is not discovery information.

layers.source: Derived from pre-2026 occurrence-bearing island/land components
layers.resolution: component hierarchy over the same NDVI support universe
layers.development_result: Explicit island/component conditioning worsens both 1-km and 500-m complete-recovery envelopes. Sparse local occurrence sets over-constrain the environmental envelope; global NDVI transfer is stronger.

layers.source: GSI DEM + ESA NDVI + WorldCover water/coast
layers.resolution: GSI-derived ~25 m terrain features, ESA 10 m vegetation/coast inputs
layers.development_result: No 1-km score family beats the 867-cell NDVI state frontier. At 500 m, nearest NDVI+physics reduces the complete-recovery envelope to 6148/22783 = 26.98%, from 7853/22783 = 34.47% for NDVI alone.

layers.source: Existing ACSP deterministic complete-link zone aggregation applied to the current NDVI support surface
layers.resolution: bounded survey patches from ~100 m support cells

cell_support: complete 19/19 development recovery at the declared radius, or explicit proof of the achievable ceiling
lower candidate-grid fraction or route/search budget than the current best
lower matched-random complete-recovery probability when candidate-count compression is claimed
patch_support: fewer operational survey patches or lower searched patch area for 19/19
bounded non-chain patches using outcome-blind construction
matched random patch sets reported at the same island-specific patch budget
promotion_rule.negative_results: Retain failed layers and harmful feature combinations as explicit ablations; do not add variables merely because they are available.
